categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded after goods receipt
categories.description: Item is resolved via 3-way matching where the invoice is recorded after the goods receipt. This alternative makes a strong positive contribution to preserving value-matching control integrity and is measured against the time to clearance after goods receipt indicator.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared OR alternative id=5 in the goal model, representing the standard control-heavy matching regime.

categories.name: 3-way matched, invoice recorded before goods receipt
categories.description: Item is resolved via 3-way matching where the invoice is recorded before the goods receipt. This alternative helps maximize working-capital efficiency and is measured against the time to clearance before goods receipt indicator.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared OR alternative id=6 in the goal model, representing early invoicing prior to goods receipt.

categories.name: 2-way matched (no goods receipt required)
categories.description: Item is resolved via 2-way matching where no goods receipt is required. This alternative helps minimize procurement overhead and is measured against the 2-way match time to clearance indicator.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared OR alternative id=7 in the goal model, representing simplified matching without goods receipt.

categories.name: Resolve via consignment consumption
categories.description: Item is resolved via consignment consumption. This alternative helps minimize procurement overhead and is measured against general exception and rework rates.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared OR alternative id=13 in the goal model, representing resolution through consignment.
